promise: This car helps you show up for the life and people that matter.

cinematography.camera: intimate close-ups, hands and small details, quiet car interior, windshield perspective, destination reveal, reaction close-up
cinematography.lighting: naturalistic and warm, soft golden hour or gentle rain light
cinematography.style: cinematic, warm film grain, shallow depth of field
cinematography.color_palette: warm amber, soft cream, muted teal shadows

sound.music_style: gentle piano and strings building to a warm swell

beats.name: Ordinary moment
beats.goal: Customer in a quiet, real moment. We like them immediately.

beats.name: The small need
beats.goal: Something small but important needs them somewhere. A message, a look, a decision.
beats.camera_hint: close-up on hands or face, slow push-in, 50mm

beats.name: Grabbing the keys
beats.goal: They choose to act. Keys, door, seat, the car wakes gently.
beats.camera_hint: side three-quarter tracking as they enter the car, 35mm

beats.name: The journey
beats.goal: The drive itself becomes the moment. Weather, light, road. The car carries them.
beats.camera_hint: windshield perspective then exterior wide, gentle tracking, 24mm

beats.name: Arrival
beats.goal: They arrive just in time. Someone or something is waiting.
beats.camera_hint: medium shot of the arrival, handheld warmth, 50mm

beats.name: Emotional payoff + hero frame
beats.goal: The small emotional win, then a clean warm hero frame of customer and car. Tagline lands.
beats.camera_hint: reaction close-up then pull-back wide hero frame, 35mm
